findings.finding: The Testing section's 'Marker-first ordering pin' (a reply with BOTH a marker-wrapped payload AND an earlier plain schema-valid decoy parses to the marker payload — markers beat the selection pipeline) is the core anti-regression for E2 catch 2, but no acceptance criterion cleanly covers it.
